CONFLICT OF INTEREST DECLARATION FORM
Discretionary Grant (DG) Application
PURPOSE
The merSETA conducts grant funding processes in a manner that promotes the interests and needs of its
stakeholders and beneficiaries through best practice governance oversight and monitoring. In line with this
commitment, all Discretionary Grant (DG) applicants are required to declare any actual, potential, or
perceived conflict of interest that may influence, or be seen to influence, the grant application process.
Failure to disclose a conflict of interest may result in the disqualification of the application and/or other
appropriate action.

SECTION 3: CONFLICT OF INTEREST DECLARATION
A conflict of interest exists where a person s personal, financial, or other interests may influence or
appear to influence their actions or decisions in relation to the merSETA DG application process.
Please answer all questions below truthfully and completely.
Question Yes No
1. Do you, or does any member of your immediate family, hold any position
(employee, board member, committee member, or advisor) within the
merSETA?
2. Do you have a personal, financial, or business relationship with any
merSETA employee or board/committee member involved in evaluating or
approving DG applications?
3. Does any merSETA employee, board member, or evaluator have a financial
interest in your organisation (e.g., ownership, shareholding, or directorship)?
4. Has your organisation received any merSETA DG funding in the previous
financial year? If yes, please provide details in Section 4 below.
5. Are you aware of any other circumstance that may constitute or give rise to a
conflict of interest, whether actual, potential, or perceived?
SECTION 4: DETAILS OF CONFLICT (Complete if any answer above is Yes )
Please provide full details of the conflict of interest identified, including the nature of the conflict, the
parties involved, and any steps taken or proposed to manage or mitigate the conflict:

SECTION 5: DECLARATION AND UNDERTAKING
I, the undersigned, hereby declare that:
1. The information provided in this form is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge
and belief.
2. I understand that a conflict of interest may include any situation where personal, financial, family, or
other interests could improperly influence my judgement or the outcome of the DG application.
3. I undertake to immediately disclose any new or changed conflict of interest that arises after
submission of this form.
4. I acknowledge that the merSETA reserves the right to disqualify any application where a conflict of
interest has not been disclosed or has been misrepresented.
5. I consent to the merSETA verifying the information provided and taking appropriate action in
accordance with its policies and applicable legislation.
